source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: يوم الجمعة، عزمنا عمي وعيلته عالغدا.
sentences.en: On Friday, we invited my uncle and his family for lunch.

sentences.ar: إمي قامت الصبح بكير وبلشت تطبخ.
sentences.en: My mom got up early in the morning and started cooking.
She cooked maqluba, stuffed grape leaves, and salads.
The smell of food filled the whole house.

sentences.ar: لما إجوا، رحبنا فيهم وقعدناهم بالصالون.
sentences.en: When they came, we welcomed them and seated them in the living room.

sentences.ar: قدمنا القهوة والولاد لعبوا مع بعض.
sentences.en: We served coffee and the kids played together.

sentences.ar: بوقت الغدا، قعدنا كلنا حول الطاولة.
sentences.en: At lunchtime, we all sat around the table.

sentences.ar: الأكل كان بيتهني والحكي ما وقف.
sentences.en: The food was delicious and the talking didn't stop.

sentences.ar: بعد الغدا، شربنا شاي وأكلنا حلويات.
sentences.en: After lunch, we drank tea and ate sweets.

sentences.ar: راحوا آخر النهار والبيت كان مليان فرح.
sentences.en: They left at the end of the day and the house was full of joy.
